description: Fresh hidden-test tasks generated before this evaluator manifest was published.

tasks.description: Update _escape_inner so equals signs are escaped as = while preserving every existing escaping rule.
tasks.test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from markupsafe._native import _escape_inner; assert _escape_inner('a=b') == 'a=b'; assert _escape_inner('&<>') == '&<>'; assert _escape_inner(chr(39)) == '''"

tasks.description: Make is_normalized_name return False for non-string values instead of raising, while preserving current behavior for strings.
tasks.test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from packaging.utils import is_normalized_name; assert is_normalized_name(42) is False; assert is_normalized_name(None) is False; assert is_normalized_name('requests') is True; assert is_normalized_name('Django') is False"

tasks.description: Extend parse_sdist_filename to accept .tgz as an alias for .tar.gz, preserving all existing validation and return types.
tasks.test_command: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from packaging.utils import parse_sdist_filename; from packaging.version import Version; assert parse_sdist_filename('demo_pkg-1.2.tgz') == ('demo-pkg', Version('1.2')); assert parse_sdist_filename('demo_pkg-1.2.tar.gz') == ('demo-pkg', Version('1.2'))"

tasks.description: Update escapeStringRegexp so forward slashes are escaped as \x2f, while preserving every existing escape and TypeError behavior.
tasks.test_command: node --input-type=module -e "import escape from './index.js'; if (escape('a/b') !== String.raw`a\x2fb`) process.exit(1); if (escape('a-b') !== String.raw`a\x2db`) process.exit(2); let rejected=false; try { escape(2); } catch (error) { rejected=error instanceof TypeError; } if (!rejected) process.exit(3)"

tasks.description: Make Queue.enqueue return the queue's new size after insertion, preserving all queue behavior.
tasks.test_command: node --input-type=module -e "import Queue from './index.js'; const q=new Queue(); if (q.enqueue('a') !== 1 || q.enqueue('b') !== 2 || q.size !== 2) process.exit(1); if (q.dequeue() !== 'a' || q.size !== 1) process.exit(2)"

tasks.description: Extend Queue.drain with an optional nonnegative limit. It must yield at most that many items and leave the rest queued; with no limit it must retain current drain-all behavior.
tasks.test_command: node --input-type=module -e "import Queue from './index.js'; const q=new Queue(); [1,2,3].forEach(x=>q.enqueue(x)); if (JSON.stringify([...q.drain(2)]) !== '[1,2]' || q.size !== 1 || q.peek() !== 3) process.exit(1); if ([...q.drain(0)].length !== 0 || q.size !== 1) process.exit(2); if (JSON.stringify([...q.drain()]) !== '[3]' || q.size !== 0) process.exit(3); let rejected=false; try { [...q.drain(-1)]; } catch { rejected=true; } if (!rejected) process.exit(4)"

tasks.description: Change Queue.peek so an empty queue returns null instead of undefined, preserving non-empty behavior.
tasks.test_command: node --input-type=module -e "import Queue from './index.js'; const q=new Queue(); if (q.peek() !== null) process.exit(1); q.enqueue('value'); if (q.peek() !== 'value' || q.size !== 1) process.exit(2)"
